# GlareMap

> Spatial glare heatmap + targeted softening for photophobia. Comfort aid — not a medical device.

- Source: https://github.com/markkirby125/glaremap
- Lab page: `index.html` (paste HTML / URL best-effort)
- Bookmarklet: built via `npm run build` → exported from the lab page
- Honesty: relative brightness estimate, not a photometric glare measurement; image/video/gradient regions marked "unmeasured".
